description.en-US:
A map for cycling, hiking and public transport in Switzerland, in the spirit of the old
GPS boxes: one screen, big buttons, the official hiking trails, cycling routes and
public-transport lines in their signpost colours on the swisstopo map. Routing runs on
the phone (BRouter, OpenStreetMap data), through as many stops as you like, previewed
before you start (distance, time, climb, the streets taken, every turn with its street
name), then turn-by-turn guidance that goes on with the screen off; your own tours (GPX,
KML, GeoJSON, TCX, FIT files, or recorded) are kept and followed as they are, and
the signposted routes of SwitzerlandMobility (on foot, barrier-free, bike, mountain bike) are
listed nearest first, offline. Public transport: the next
journeys to your stop, drawn leg by leg, then guidance in big letters (walk, board, get
off, change) with real-time timetables online and an optional offline timetable of all
Switzerland. What is around you, offline: drinking water, shelters, huts, fire places,
bike shops, bakeries, cafés, restaurants, shops, practices, firms… from OpenStreetMap, searched by
category or name (with a town: « Ardentis Lausanne ») in one search with addresses, stops and favourites, shown on the map, each with its card (open now, hours, phone, add to
contacts). The firms of the Swiss commercial register, offline (about 789 000, at their
registered address), and the address of one of your contacts through Android's picker.
Favourites, people and firms from the
search.ch directory with your own key, which also completes a place with its phone and
address; a night map, and the whole country saved offline in one button. A route planner
on every map (start, destination, date and time, share, keep). Six languages. No
account, no tracking: the network serves the map tiles, the downloads and searches you
ask for, and the transit map sends your position to transport.opendata.ch to find the
stops around you.
